findings.description: I-1: Cut out and repave damaged bituminous paving after compacting base (west parking wheel well depressions, east drive lane deterioration, map cracked/settled paving along rear inlets); seal inlet perimeters with hot applied asphaltic sealer
I-2: Examine all rear precast concrete lintels and replace cracked, damaged or sagging ones (temporary masonry support); scrape, prime and paint rusting steel angle lintels and guard angles
I-3: Prep and paint exterior walls with elastomeric paint to prevent water absorption into block; paint exterior loading and personnel doors; approx $0.80 per SF

I-4: Roof deck repairs - rusted/buckled deck in Clarksville Construction space (also Suites K and H); approx 350 of deck suspect, replace at approx $45.00/SF incl. roofing and insulation removal and reinstall; engineer evaluation recommended
I-5: Remove at least two abandoned rooftop units and properly flash openings
I-6: Roof membrane tune-up - qualified roofer to examine and repair open seams/laps with compatible EPDM sealants and repair holes in flashings at masonry fire walls
I-7: Repair or replace three severely rusted egress platforms on east end
I-8: Repair trip hazards at front sidewalk (near Space P and one other location)
RR-1: Allowance to repair and re-stripe lot surface, $8,000 each in Years 3 and 8
RR-2: Minor masonry repairs on rear walls and exterior paint, plus painting exterior and loading doors (narrative: around Year 9; table: Year 8)
